hero.eyebrow: A calmer way to make progress
hero.description: Bring your tasks, goals, and habits together in one simple workspace. Find your focus, build consistency, and move forward with a little help from AI.
hero.tagline: Your goals. Your pace. Your progress.

preview.subtitle: Monday, a fresh start
preview.aiMessage: "Try breaking your goal into smaller steps. A little progress every day adds up!"
preview.closingLine: A little more clarity. A little less overwhelm.

features.heading: Your life, a little more organized.

tasks.title: Tasks that flow

goals.title: Goals with direction
goals.description: Set meaningful goals, track your progress, and break big ambitions into achievable steps.

habits.title: Habits that stick
habits.description: Build consistent routines, track your streaks, and celebrate the small wins that add up.

ai.title: An AI assistant
ai.description: Think through your plans, ask questions, and get AI-powered guidance when you need it.

steps.heading: Progress isn't about doing everything. It's about knowing what comes next.
